[P2] Include the new operations in examples-package coverage

Root AGENTS.md Tests rule 3 and CONTRIBUTING require examples-package coverage for new SDK features and API changes. This manually deployed handler is outside that integration workflow and exercises no decider operation; the diff adds no examples-package files. A deployed decision model is unnecessary for demonstrating replay through the supported custom transport. Return to the testing design and include named examples with integration/history assertions for the new public operations.
